pages.text: GregTech uses EU for electrical energy. A machine’s voltage tier determines the recipes and power it can handle; a recipe’s EU/t describes its demand while running.

Check the generator, cables and receiving machine together. A suitable machine still needs enough power delivered through suitable connections. Higher voltage requires equipment designed to accept it.$(br2)When planning a network, consider the machines you will run at the same time. A setup that works for one machine may struggle when several start together.
